nodes.name: Get Outreach Ready Leads
nodes.notes: Eligibility is enforced here AND in Sender Eligibility Guard. Absence excludes: a NULL client_id or research_summary is simply not selected.

={{ JSON.stringify({ p_lead_id: $json.p_lead_id, p_outreach_sent_at: $json.p_outreach_sent_at, p_followup_scheduled_at: $json.p_followup_scheduled_at, p_lead_status: $json.p_lead_status, p_outreach_channel: $json.p_outreach_channel, p_total_emails_sent: $json.p_total_emails_sent, p_last_email_sent_at: $json.p_last_email_sent_at }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ workflow_name: $json.workflow_name, node_name: $json.node_name, error_code: $json.error_code, error_message: $json.error_message, input_data: $json.input_data }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ workflow_name: 'CLX-Outreach-Sender-v2', node_name: 'send_failed', error_code: 'GMAIL_SEND_FAILED', error_message: $json.send_error || 'Unknown Gmail error', input_data: { lead_id: $json.id, recipient: $json.email, subject: $json.email_subject, city: $json.city, industry: $json.industry, client_id: $json.client_id } }) }}

nodes.notes: The final boundary. Ownership, research, a valid score, consent, entitlement, an authorized campaign, an enabled channel and an autonomy level that permits execution -- all required, all fail-closed. Outreach Ready alone authorizes nothing.
